subject: Vendor onboarding: BrightFolio token request + split-PO & VAT routing
messages:
From: BrightFolio AP <ap@brightfolio.com>

Cc: BrightFolio Billing <billing@brightfolio.com>
Date: Sun, 26 Apr 2026 08:12:00 +0000
Subject: BrightFolio vendor activation + split PO handling / VAT reverse-charge

Hi Neha,

We're ready to onboard Redwood Inference as a vendor in BrightFolio's Artemis Procurement Hub. Before we create the vendor record we need the following from your side so our AP and automated remittance can work without delays: 

- Legal entity name + billing entity you want invoices to be issued to (for EU VAT purposes)
- Bank remittance details (IBAN, SWIFT) and preferred remit currency
- Tax classification and VAT registration number for the billing entity (we're in the UK, reverse-charge may apply)
- DUNS (if available) and primary invoice contact
- Confirmation if you support 'split PO' semantics: our subscription invoices may be covered by multiple PO references (example: monthly subscription invoice referencing PO 5012 and PO 5020). We need to know if your invoice lines can accept multiple PO numbers or if you require a single PO per invoice.

Also: Do you offer a vendor token (one-time API token or vendor id) we can attach to our PO-to-invoice automation so our system can automatically match receipts? If so, we'd like a temporary token for a test payment (BF-TEST-001).

I've attached our AP onboarding packet and a sample invoice to show the PO split example. If you need an invoice template from our side to ensure matchability, let me know.

Attachments: [BrightFolio_AP_Packet_v1.pdf], [BrightFolio_Sample_Invoice_BF-INV-20260401.pdf]

Thanks,

Sara Lewis
Senior AP Manager | BrightFolio
ap@brightfolio.com | +44 20 7123 4455

--
Note: our system requires vendor activation + remit verification before the first release of funds.
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 26 Apr 2026 11:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: BrightFolio vendor activation + split PO handling / VAT reverse-charge

Hi Sara — thanks for the packet and the sample invoice. We're excited to get this set up. Quick answers and next steps below: 

1) Entity & tax: Our billing entity for BrightFolio will be Redwood Inference Ltd. VAT: GB999888777. We will include that on the invoice and can provide certificate if you need it for reverse-charge validation.

2) Bank details: I'll attach our standard remit sheet on the onboarding form. For testing you can use the temporary reference BF-TEST-001.

3) Vendor token: Yes — we can provision a one-time vendor token (vendor_id) scoped to your account so your reconciliation job can programmatically append it to POs. We can provide a test token that expires after 7 days; production tokens require an onboarding checklist and bank verification.

4) Split PO handling: We can accept multiple PO references per invoice but need them on invoice line metadata (separate field) to enable automatic matching. If your system sends all PO numbers in the invoice header only, our AP matching will require manual intervention. If you can put PO references at the line level or include an invoice-level PO array (example provided), our matching success rate >95%.

5) EU VAT / reverse-charge: For UK buyers we'll mark the invoice as reverse-charge where applicable, but we need to know the buyer's VAT id for your company in the invoice payload. We can also toggle 'self-bill' if your process requires BrightFolio to self-bill Redwood (we've done this with other enterprise customers).

Next steps:
- Please complete the 'Vendor registration' section in our onboarding form (link below) and upload the filled AP packet + sample PO CSV.
- I'll provision a 7-day test token once we receive the completed packet and a scanned bank verification page from your side.

Onboarding form: https://app.redwoodinference.com/onboarding/vendor-form?ref=BF-0426

If you want a joint 30-minute call to walk an engineer through the token test and sample PO/IN payload, I'm free tomorrow 09:00-11:00 UTC.

Best,

Neha Kapoor
FinOps, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com | +1 415 555 0192

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding BrightFolio's AP packet. High level asks: vendor token for automated matching, support for multiple PO refs per invoice, and EU reverse-charge handling. Quick items I need from you both: 

- Marissa: Can we enable 'line-level PO array' matching for this account instead of raising manual exceptions? If not, we need to coordinate a short runbook for AP to handle split-PO invoices from BrightFolio. Also flag if this account should be marked for 30-day payment term exception during first 2 cycles.

- Karthik: For EU reverse-charge we usually require (1) buyer VAT id in payload, (2) buyer country, and (3) signed self-bill agreement if BrightFolio wants to self-bill. Do we require EORI or VAT certificate upload in their onboarding packet? If so, I can request it.

Proposed timeline: receive completed packet today -> test token provisioned this afternoon -> test PO BF-TEST-001 runs tomorrow morning.

Thanks — let me know if you want me to table any of this for the weekly AP sync.

—Neha
